import { Component, inject, signal, computed } from '@angular/core'; import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common'; import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms'; import { ExportImportDataService } from '../../services/export-import-data.service'; @Component({ selector: 'app-rfq-calculator', standalone: true, imports: [CommonModule, FormsModule], template: `
Interactive Export Tool

Container Load & FOB/CIF Quote Estimator

Calculate container volume capacity (CBM), weight limits, and instantly estimate export contract quotes in your preferred currency.

Export Order Configuration Keya Export Desk

Fabric Weight / Density (GSM) {{ gsmValue }} GSM
140 GSM (Light Jersey) 200 GSM (Standard Polo) 320 GSM (Heavy Fleece)
Live Proforma Estimate

Calculated Summary

{{ dataService.currentCurrency().code }} ({{ dataService.currentCurrency().symbol }})
Estimated Contract Value
{{ calculatedQuote().formattedPrice }}
Base USD: \${{ calculatedQuote().usdPrice.toLocaleString('en-US', { maximumFractionDigits: 2 }) }}
Unit Price Rate: {{ dataService.formatValue(calculatedQuote().unitPriceUSD) }} / unit
Total Cargo Volume (CBM): {{ calculatedQuote().cbm.toFixed(1) }} CBM
Container Utilization Capacity: {{ calculatedQuote().utilizationPercentage.toFixed(1) }}%
Estimated Gross Weight: {{ (calculatedQuote().weightKg / 1000).toFixed(2) }} Metric Tons
Container Volume Filling {{ calculatedQuote().utilizationPercentage.toFixed(0) }}%
@if (calculatedQuote().utilizationPercentage > 100) {

⚠️ Note: Order volume exceeds single container capacity. Split into multiple FCL containers.

}
✓ All quotes include OEKO-TEX testing, standard export cartooning & FOB Chattogram documentation.
@if (showQuoteSuccessModal()) {
✓

Proforma Quote Generated

Reference ID: RFQ-KEYA-2026-902

Estimated Value: {{ calculatedQuote().formattedPrice }} ({{ dataService.currentCurrency().code }})

Export Desk Contact: export@keyagroupbd.com
Gazipur HQ Phone: +880-2-9812900
}
` }) export class RfqCalculatorComponent { dataService = inject(ExportImportDataService); selectedProduct = 'polo'; containerType = '40ft'; orderQuantity = 25000; incoterm = 'fob'; gsmValue = 200; showQuoteSuccessModal = signal(false); // Dynamic Quote Calculation calculatedQuote = computed(() => { let basePriceUSD = 5.0; let cbmPerUnit = 0.0018; // cubic meter per unit let weightPerUnitKg = 0.22; if (this.selectedProduct === 'polo') { basePriceUSD = 5.0 + (this.gsmValue - 200) * 0.015; cbmPerUnit = 0.0018; weightPerUnitKg = (this.gsmValue / 200) * 0.22; } else if (this.selectedProduct === 'tshirt') { basePriceUSD = 2.80 + (this.gsmValue - 200) * 0.01; cbmPerUnit = 0.0014; weightPerUnitKg = (this.gsmValue / 200) * 0.16; } else if (this.selectedProduct === 'hoodie') { basePriceUSD = 9.50 + (this.gsmValue - 200) * 0.02; cbmPerUnit = 0.0035; weightPerUnitKg = (this.gsmValue / 200) * 0.48; } else if (this.selectedProduct === 'yarn') { basePriceUSD = 4.50; cbmPerUnit = 0.0022; weightPerUnitKg = 1.0; } else if (this.selectedProduct === 'soap') { basePriceUSD = 0.45; cbmPerUnit = 0.0003; weightPerUnitKg = 0.12; } else if (this.selectedProduct === 'detergent') { basePriceUSD = 1.20; cbmPerUnit = 0.0012; weightPerUnitKg = 1.0; } // Incoterm adjustment multiplier let incotermMultiplier = 1.0; if (this.incoterm === 'cif_eu') incotermMultiplier = 1.08; if (this.incoterm === 'cif_usa') incotermMultiplier = 1.12; if (this.incoterm === 'cif_uae') incotermMultiplier = 1.06; const unitPriceUSD = basePriceUSD * incotermMultiplier; const usdPrice = unitPriceUSD * this.orderQuantity; const totalCbm = cbmPerUnit * this.orderQuantity; const totalWeightKg = weightPerUnitKg * this.orderQuantity; // Container capacity CBM const containerMaxCbm = this.containerType === '20ft' ? 33.2 : (this.containerType === '40ft' ? 76.4 : 50.0); const utilizationPercentage = (totalCbm / containerMaxCbm) * 100; return { unitPriceUSD, usdPrice, formattedPrice: this.dataService.formatValue(usdPrice), cbm: totalCbm, weightKg: totalWeightKg, utilizationPercentage }; }); }
